page.content:
Dick's 1968 novel of bounty hunters and empathy.

How Do Androids Dream of Electric Sheep? connects

  • Creator: Philip K. Dick — Philip K. Dick wrote Do Androids Dream of Electric Sheep?
  • Topic: Blade Runner — Dick's novel is the source work of Blade Runner.
  • Work: Blade Runner (1982) — The novel was adapted into Blade Runner (1982).
  • Work: Blade Runner (1982) — The 1982 film is adapted from Dick's novel.

What is Do Androids Dream of Electric Sheep??

Do Androids Dream of Electric Sheep? follows Rick Deckard hunting escaped androids in a ruined San Francisco of kipple, Mercerism, and the Voigt-Kampff test.

Key threads lead to Philip K. Dick, Blade Runner, Blade Runner (1982) and Blade Runner (1982).
